versions.content: Handling of RESPONSE and ERROR Message Types The SOME/IP transformer shall use the Return Code error Handling for Message Type RESPONSE(0x80) according to [PRS_SOMEIP_00901] when receiving error re- sponses. The SOME/IP transformer shall also handle responses of Message Type ER- ROR(0x81) according to [PRS_SOMEIP_00902] and [PRS_SOMEIP_00903] but with- out using the Payload of the Error Message, since this is not yet supported by this version of the SOME/IP transformer. Only the Return Code value is used in this case. See [SWS_SomeIpXf_00149].
